sourceEvidence.title: Manufacturing Process Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
* BS in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum of five (5) years of experience in manufacturing engineering, quality engineering, or a related field.
* Experience implementing and supporting Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) in a manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing automation, smart torque systems, industrial traceability, and Industry 4.0 technologies.
* Experience conducting root cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions using structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple improvement initiatives simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Experience with automated assembly equipment, robotics, vision inspection systems, and manufacturing data analytics.
* Experience supporting multiple manufacturing facilities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and manufacturing data analysis tools.
**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Working knowledge of thermal cooling equipment.
* Working knowledge of metal cutting and bending.
* High degree of knowledge with brazing and welding.
* Experience integrating manufacturing systems with ERP, PLC, and industrial automation platforms.
